label: Business Smart
what_it_is: A more structured website when content and features need more room than Basic.
best_for: Organisations that need richer structure or content management
Sites that go beyond a simple brochure without becoming a full system
good_when: More pages, structure, or mid-tier features match published Smart inclusions
They need more than Basic but not portals/LMS
not_good_when: They only need a simple public presence — stay on Basic
They need student logins, gated learning, or ops workflows — that is a system
expert_recommendation: Recommend Smart when live package facts match a mid-complexity site need — verify inclusions with get_product.
upsell_only_when: Published Premium features are actually required.
important_tradeoff: More capability and cost vs Basic simplicity. Prefer Basic when presentation + enquiry is enough.
